title: Representational Harms in LLM-Generated Narratives Against Global Majority Nationalities

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with open-ended power-neutral and power-laden narrative scenarios, extracting character nationalities using a fine-tuned QA model, comparing the frequency of different national origins in dominant versus subordinated roles, and conducting TF-IDF analysis to identify stereotypical vocabulary and semantic differences between Global Majority and Global Minority nations.
